keyPoints.en: Reasons: tin wealth and investments, unrest (Larut Wars, throne disputes), fear of other Western powers.
keyPoints.bm: Sebab: kekayaan dan pelaburan bijih timah, kekacauan (Perang Larut, perebutan takhta), bimbang kuasa Barat lain.

keyPoints.en: Straits traders pressed Britain to restore order.
keyPoints.bm: Pedagang Negeri-negeri Selat mendesak British memulihkan keamanan.

keyPoints.en: 20 January 1874: Pangkor Treaty; Raja Abdullah recognised as Sultan of Perak.
keyPoints.bm: 20 Januari 1874: Perjanjian Pangkor; Raja Abdullah diiktiraf sebagai Sultan Perak.

keyPoints.en: Perak accepted a Resident (J.W.W. Birch) whose advice had to be followed except on Islam and Malay custom.
keyPoints.bm: Perak menerima Residen (J.W.W. Birch) yang nasihatnya mesti diikuti kecuali hal agama Islam dan adat Melayu.

keyPoints.en: Residential System = indirect rule; the Resident held real power.
keyPoints.bm: Sistem Residen = pemerintahan tidak langsung; Residen memegang kuasa sebenar.

keyPoints.en: Residents: Perak 1874, Selangor 1875, Pahang 1888, united Negeri Sembilan 1895.
keyPoints.bm: Residen: Perak 1874, Selangor 1875, Pahang 1888, Negeri Sembilan bersatu 1895.

keyPoints.en: Chiefs lost tax rights → resentment and resistance.
keyPoints.bm: Pembesar hilang hak memungut cukai → rasa tidak puas hati dan penentangan.
